substeps.caption: A polished coupon on a slide goes under the clips: reflection mode, for opaque metal samples.

The LED beside the optics module lights the sample through the objective via the beamsplitter; the camera looks down through it. The stage scans x/y on four flexure legs that lean and shear with it; the X and Y actuators pull the front two as levers. The optics focus.
Back to centre. Printed in PLA, about 170 mm across; several fit on one tray.
